name: @javis-dog/collector-claude-code
description: Claude Code collector. S3c: `javi` CLI (init, hook, flush, status, uninstall), exec-form async command hooks, allowlist mapping to JGR L0 with salted session/agent refs, persistent per-thread sequences, file spool with detached delivery (ADR-0010). S3e: token/cost usage from Claude Code OTel metrics via a local OTLP receiver (ADR-0011). S3f: self-contained bundle + tarball (`npx ./javis-dog-javi-<version>.tgz`), stable copy under ~/.javi/bin. S5b: `--platform gemini-cli` (ADR-0016) — Gemini CLI hooks in the project's .gemini/settings.json, opt-in user-level Gemini telemetry to the same receiver (logs/traces drained unread), Gemini token usage with estimated cost via JD-C02. S5c: `--platform codex-cli` (ADR-0016 Changes S5c) — stable launcher ~/.javi/bin/javi-hook, append-only groups in the project's .codex/hooks.json (approval left to Codex), logs-only [otel] block in $CODEX_HOME/config.toml, receiver path /v1/logs/codex-cli (tokens, API-key cost, sub-agents attributed to their parent), proxy and header guards.
provides: dist/javi.mjs bundle (pnpm build), javis-dog-javi tarball (pnpm pack:cli)
javi --platform <claude-code|gemini-cli|codex-cli> (init, uninstall, status, hook, usage on|off)
